entries.name: undo
entries.description: Undo your last commit but keep its changes staged.

entries.name: unstage
entries.description: Take files out of the staging area without losing changes.

entries.name: discard
entries.description: Throw away unstaged changes in tracked files.
entries.warning: Changes you discard cannot be recovered.

entries.name: wipe
entries.description: Return every tracked file to the last commit.
entries.warning: Deletes all uncommitted work in tracked files.
